sourceInstance.label: Source instance
sourceInstance.help: Use auto to detect all ecovacs-deebot.* instances, or enter one instance such as ecovacs-deebot.0.

positionRefreshInterval.label: Position fallback (seconds)
positionRefreshInterval.help: Additional polling for live position if the source adapter does not emit reliable state events.

roomConfigInfo.text: Detected rooms are listed automatically. To merge rooms for VIS, enter multiple comma-separated SpotArea IDs in Room ID(s), for example 2,3. Enter the desired display name in Custom display name. Original Ecovacs rooms and states remain unchanged.

items.title: Room ID(s)
items.help: One ID per room or multiple comma-separated IDs to merge, e.g. 2,3.
